goal: Allow an active company employee to authorize, install, and open Dianchi Desktop Assistant through Feishu OAuth while denying non-employees and preserving stable pet identity.

target_architecture.identity_gate: Feishu OAuth identity resolved against a signed employee authorization snapshot
target_architecture.desktop_handoff: 60-second one-time code exchanged by the installed desktop app
target_architecture.installer_distribution: immutable Windows and macOS artifacts on Vercel Blob
target_architecture.pet_identity: stable employee_id bound by a short-lived signed desktop assertion

acceptance_criteria.description: Only active employees from the company tenant pass the OAuth gate; unknown, pending, disabled, or external identities receive no desktop authorization.
acceptance_criteria.verification: uv run python -m unittest discover -s /Users/dianchi/dianchi/tests -p test_oauth_employee_gate.py -v

acceptance_criteria.description: The browser sends only a short-lived one-time code through the dianchi URL protocol, and replay or expired exchange attempts fail.
acceptance_criteria.verification: uv run python -m unittest discover -s /Users/dianchi/dianchi/tests -p test_desktop_auth.py -v

acceptance_criteria.description: The existing desktop is detected through an explicit protocol heartbeat; otherwise the employee receives the matching installer with a visible retry path.
acceptance_criteria.verification: uv run python -m unittest discover -s /Users/dianchi/dianchi/tests -p test_desktop_bootstrap.py -v

acceptance_criteria.description: Windows and macOS release artifacts use immutable version paths, declared size and SHA-256 integrity, and stable releases require signed artifacts.
acceptance_criteria.verification: uv run python -m unittest discover -s /Users/dianchi/dianchi-desktop/tests -p test_packaging_contract.py -v

acceptance_criteria.description: Desktop authorization binds the existing pet system to the same stable employee_id without allowing unsigned identity fields or session takeover.
The packaged desktop handles probe and authorization links on Windows x64 and macOS arm64 while preserving the official Feishu Messenger 25/75 message layout.
